title: V-8 454 ENGINE H.D. HOOD & HOOD DECAL
summary: RPO LS7 454 heavy-duty V-8: hood panel (big-block hood with raised center/power bulge) with the hood bulge side moldings (chrome trim pieces at the rear opening of the bulge, LH/RH) and the 'LS-7' hood decal. Each molding has its own threaded studs (no separate stud callout) that pass through the hood and take nuts from underneath. The LS-7 decal is placed per View A.

fastening.note: Molding [4] has its own threaded studs (no separate callout) that pass through holes in the hood; nuts [3] go on from underneath.

fastening.to: hood panel [1], side of the bulge
